note: Shared by both editions. Every factual field is an object carrying value and source. Where todo_verify is true the value has not been confirmed against a primary source and must not be relied on. See verification-queue.json for the open items.

editions.en: Implementer-facing. Facts and specifications. Path in doc_en.
editions.zh: Shop-owner-facing. Written separately, not a translation. Covers material the English edition does not, and carries additional open items of its own. Path in doc_zh.

source_types.official-authority: Published or administered by a named government body identified in the country record. Confirm against that body's own publication.
source_types.public-regulation: Derives from published law, decree or regulation. Confirm against the current text including amendments.
source_types.unverified: Not attributable to either of the above as written. Treat as unknown.

standard_gst_rate_percent.note: Flat, with no scheduled expiry. GST-free and input-taxed categories exist, notably most basic food, defined by schedule.

gst_free_food.note: Basic food is generally GST-free, prepared and packaged food generally not. Per-product tax categories are unavoidable for grocery catalogues.

fiscal_system.note: No fiscalisation for retail. Peppol e-invoicing exists for B2B and B2G contexts.

required_fields_under_1000: that the document is intended to be a tax invoice
brief description including quantity and price
receipt.note: The POS must be able to produce a compliant tax invoice on demand, including after the fact.

definition: three or more instalments including any deposit
goods not supplied until paid in full

gst_attribution_timing.note: Determines what the business activity statement reports. Cannot be guessed.

payment_notes.bnpl_note: Each provider settles and reconciles on its own terms; treat each as a distinct tender type.

countries.dst_note: Some states observe daylight saving and others do not. A multi-store deployment cannot assume one offset; the business-day boundary must be per-store.

effective_vat_rate_percent.mechanism: tax base of 11/12 of selling price
effective_vat_rate_percent.note: Implement the base adjustment, not a flat 11 percent. Rounding differs on some amounts.

payment_notes.note: One merchant QR accepts participating wallets and banks; no per-wallet integration needed.

typical_price_magnitude.note: Order of magnitude only, for field sizing. Not price data.

active_rates_percent.note: Exempt supplies are a separate category from zero-rated.

fiscal_system.predecessor: register-based regime using ETR devices and control units

scope_extended.note: Obligation extended beyond VAT-registered businesses to taxpayers generally, including small traders and professionals.

mandatory_fields_draft: buyer PIN where input tax is claimed

legal_invoice_number_source.note: The legal invoice number is returned by the control unit, not generated by the POS.

cash_rounding.note: Record as its own amount, not a price adjustment.

model.note: No input-tax credit chain. Sales tax typically levied at manufacture or import rather than at each sale. Do not reuse a VAT data model.

individual_invoice_required_above_myr.note: Consolidation no longer permitted above this value. Reaches the till: the cashier may need a TIN mid-transaction.

languages.note: Chinese is in genuine commercial use here, unlike most markets in this repository. Per-user language selection across ms/en/zh rather than a fixed back-office/till split.

price_volatility.note: Bulk repricing, effective-dated prices and change history are worth more here than a static catalogue import.

fiscal_system.note: Invoice submitted for validation before being provided to the buyer.

reported_variants: medium businesses by July 2026, small businesses by July 2027
phases.resolution: Must be confirmed with FIRS directly. Do not rely on either variant.

b2c_in_scope.note: Most important open question. A clearance model at a retail counter, where waiting is unacceptable, requires a different design.

payment_notes.note: A day of takings arrives as many small transfers. Matching them to sales depends entirely on references captured at the till.

connectivity.note: In a clearance model the permitted catch-up behaviour is a compliance question, not an engineering choice.

typical_price_magnitude.note: Order of magnitude only, for field sizing. Not price data.

cash_rounding.note: Cash settles to the nearest ten centimos while card and wallet settle to the exact centavo. Model the difference as its own amount on the sale.

currency.authority_to_confirm: Banco Central de Reserva del Peru

standard_vat_rate_percent.name: IGV
standard_vat_rate_percent.composition_note: 16% IGV component plus a 2% municipal promotion component (IPM), quoted and printed as a single figure.

reduced_rate_percent.applies_to: micro and small enterprises in restaurants, hotels and tourist lodging, subject to income and activity-mix conditions
reduced_rate_percent.note: Directly relevant to food-service operators. Do not assume a single 18% rate covers the catalogue.

fiscal_system.authority: SUNAT (Superintendencia Nacional de Aduanas y de Administracion Tributaria)
fiscal_system.document_format: structured XML registered with the authority, which returns an acceptance response

additional_levies.name: selective consumption tax
additional_levies.note: Forms part of the base for IGV. A flat percentage-per-line tax model cannot express this.

document_type_depends_on_customer.note: Consumer and business sales are different legal documents chosen at the point of sale.

document_types.name: Nota de credito / Nota de debito

mandatory_fields_draft: item description, quantity, unit price, line total
separately levied taxes as their own lines
reference to original document for credit and debit notes

qr_code_required.scope_note: Attaches to the taxpayer's own emission system (SEE-Del contribuyente); reportedly not to SUNAT's web and free-facturador routes. Confirm scope.

print_constraints.position: lower part of the printed representation

languages.official_note: Quechua and Aymara hold official status where they predominate. Commercial documents and POS interfaces are in Spanish.

encoding_notes.failure_is_subtle: Symptoms are mild enough to reach production unnoticed. Test with deliberately accented data.

languages.description_length_vs_english: longer, commonly by a fifth or more

accreditation.note: Gating dependency with lead time. The machine must be registered before it may issue receipts.

eis.name: Electronic Invoicing System
eis.group_1: taxpayers using CAS or invoicing software

statutory_discounts.name: Senior Citizen and PWD discount
statutory_discounts.note: Model in the tax engine, not the discount engine. Most common way to get the Philippines wrong; surfaces at audit rather than at the till.

required_machine_behaviours: sequential numbering that cannot be reset or reused
machine registration details printed on the receipt

languages.note: An English till needs no translation and creates no hiring barrier.

separator_convention.note: The two conventions invert each other. Set explicitly; do not inherit a locale default.

standard_vat_rate_percent.note: Proposed rises to 15.5 percent (2025-05-01) and 16 percent (2026-04-01) were reversed; the 2026 Budget confirmed 15 percent for 2026/27.

receipt.note: Same shape of problem as Peru: the cashier must know which document the customer needs.

software_must_support: stock reserved, not sold, until paid in full
instalments recorded against an open agreement, each receipted
a customer-facing document stating the terms
layby.note: Modelling as unrelated part-payments loses the agreement, the reservation and the audit trail.

payment_notes.note: Card-heavy by regional standards; terminal integration matters more than in mobile-money markets.

connectivity.note: Scheduled and unscheduled outages are a defining local constraint. Test abrupt power loss mid-transaction, not just network loss. Battery-backed hardware is baseline.

standard_vat_rate_percent.note: Nearest expiry in this repository. Reverts to the 10 percent statutory rate unless extended.

fiscal_system.note: Voluntary; no legislated B2B mandate reported for 2026 or 2027. Tax incentives for adoption.
fiscal_system.transmission: monthly by the 15th of the following month

receipt.note: Omitting any of these blocks the buyer's input VAT claim.

calendar.rule: Store one canonical form and convert at render time.

encoding_notes.line_breaking: requires a dictionary-based or ICU-style algorithm; cannot split on whitespace
encoding_notes.stacked_marks: vowel signs above and below the consonant plus tone marks; measure display width, not codepoint count
encoding_notes.line_height: tight leading clips the upper tone marks

typical_price_magnitude.note: Order of magnitude only, for field sizing. Not price data.

temporary_rate_reduction.note: Lapses 31 December 2026 unless extended again. A hardcoded 8% produces silently wrong tax from 1 January 2027. Exact goods-level coverage still open.

fiscal_system.authority: tax administration under the Ministry of Finance
fiscal_system.framework: Decree 123/2020/ND-CP as amended by Decree 70/2025/ND-CP, effective 2025-06-01

applies_to: household and individual businesses at or above the threshold

mandatory_fields_draft: seller name, address and tax code
buyer name and tax code where an invoice is requested
invoice form and serial symbol, invoice number
item name, unit, quantity, unit price, line amount

counter_slip_and_einvoice_are_separate_d.note: The slip handed to the customer and the registered e-invoice are distinct artefacts with independent numbering and lifecycles.

encoding_notes.stacked_diacritics: Vowel-quality diacritic plus tone mark on the same letter.
